messages:
Alex Cheng: Quick sync — Aurora dedicated pool bring-up is scheduled Wed 09:00 PT. Plan outline: reserve 12 GPUs (p4d-equivalent), initial quota target 50k req/s, autoscale ceiling 65k, warmup window 2h with shadow -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% traffic shift. Need signoff on autoscale policy + failover routes.
Maria (Aurora): Thanks Alex — can you confirm KMS key rotation timing? We need keys in place before warm traffic. Also any expected throttling that will impact latency SLOs?
Ryan (SRE): KMS: we need the customer-managed key ARN by EOD Mon to pre-provision. Throttling: we'll set per-slot rate limits at LB layer; recommend soft limit 55k and hard reject at 68k. We'll surface 95p latency in dashboard.
Tina (Infra): FYI — if we hit autoscale cold-starts we can enable pre-warm containers for the first 30m of the ramp. That reduces p95 by ~120ms based on prior runs. Also propose model-variant fallback (quantized v2) if GPU pool is saturated.
Sam - Solutions: On the enablement side, Aurora ops needs a runbook snippet and one pager. I can draft the runbook and an example curl traffic recipe for load testing. Want it in writing for their SREs.
Alex Cheng: Good — action items: 1) Maria to provide KMS ARN (Maria) 2) Ryan to open a loadtest job + ID (Ryan) 3) Tina to flip on pre-warm toggle during warmup (Tina) 4) Sam to push runbook draft (Sam). I'll coordinate the Canary policy and fallback variant.
Maria (Aurora): KMS ARN sent to sec-ops via email (just now). Can we also run a small canary on their non-prod cluster Tue 14:00 PT?
Ryan (SRE): I'll schedule the loadtest. Test plan (short):
```
stress-tool run --id aurora-warmup-01 --qps 10000 --duration 30m --ramp 10m --payload bulk-1k
metrics: tokens/s, p50/p95/p99 lat, gpu_util, kv_hit
```
I'll post the test dashboard link once job queued.
Tina (Infra): Note on autoscale policies: set cooldown 90s, min_replicas 4, max_replicas 20. If gpu_util > 85% for 2 continuous minutes trigger scale-up. Also set fallback route to hosted-api (rate-limited) in case of sustained OOMs.
Alex Cheng: One more ask from renewal/CS side — if we see >3 partial failures during rollout we should pause and open a postmortem / renewal signal to account execs. Marking that as a stop-the-line criteria.
Sam - Solutions: Draft runbook uploaded: https://rwd/internal/runbooks/aurora-warmup (perm: aurora-sre + cs). It includes rollback commands and exact traffic-shift cadence.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: dedicated-pool/aurora -> warmup-config v3 at 2024-06-12T09:00:00Z :rocket:
Maria (Aurora): Appreciate the clarity. We'll have a small ops rotation on Wed and a single point-of-contact (me). Please ping if anything odd during shadow.
Ryan (SRE): Queued loadtest id aurora-warmup-01, estimated start Wed 09:05 PT (post-deploy). Dashboard: https://metrics/r/aurora/aurora-warmup-01
Tina (Infra): I'll enable pre-warm and monitor gpu temp/oom. If we see >70C or sustained mem pressure I'll flip fallback and notify.
Alex Cheng: OK — final checklist: KMS ARN received, runbook in place, loadtest queued, pre-warm on. I'll run a 08:30 PT preflight sync tomorrow to confirm knobs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maria (Aurora): Sounds good — talk tomorrow. :pray:
